final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analysts FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg COLLATE BINARY = s.transref COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY = s.trdref2 COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analysts) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.transref, step1.tradekind, step1.avg_analysts, step1.avg_analysts - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_analysts > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_analysts) AS trader_avg, AVG(difference) AS avg_difference FROM step3 GROUP BY tradekind), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(trader_avg) AS overall_trader_avg FROM step4) SELECT step4.tradekind, step4.trader_avg, step4.avg_difference, step4.trader_avg / NULLIF(step5.overall_trader_avg, 0) FROM step4 CROSS JOIN step5 WHERE step5.overall_trader_avg IS NOT NULL
